chapter 02 · words from me

A letter for you.

Hi, Rere. ♡

Happy birthday, sayang.

Aku cuma mau bilang, I'm really glad you exist. Dari sekian banyak orang di dunia ini, somehow hidup aku mempertemukan aku sama kamu—and that's one of the things I'm grateful for.

Makasih udah jadi bagian dari hari-hari aku. Makasih buat tawa, cerita, hal-hal random, dan momen kecil yang mungkin kelihatannya sederhana, tapi berarti buat aku.

Di umur kamu yang baru ini, aku berharap kamu selalu punya alasan buat bahagia, punya keberanian buat ngejar apa yang kamu mau, dan selalu dikelilingi orang-orang yang sayang sama kamu. Semoga hal-hal baik pelan-pelan nemuin jalan ke kamu.

I can't promise that every day will be perfect, but I hope I can keep learning how to love you better, listen to you, and be someone you feel safe with.

Happy birthday, my favorite person. Semoga tahun ini baik sama kamu, yaa. You deserve so much love.

with love,
Reza ♡

chapter 06 · something for you

Open your gift 🎁

There's one more little thing I want you to know.

If I could give you one thing for your birthday, I'd give you the chance to see yourself through my eyes—so you could understand how lovely, precious, and deserving of good things you are.

Semoga kamu nggak lupa betapa berharganya diri kamu. I'm always rooting for you. ♡
one last thing · from my heart

Until the stars
bring us home.

Out of all the people in this world, somehow our paths crossed.

Aku nggak tahu semua hal yang nunggu kita di depan, but I'm glad I get to know you in this lifetime.

Happy birthday, Rere. Here's to you, to us, and to all the little moments we haven't lived yet. ♡
